subject: Green councillor charged with assaults
posts:
When community representatives turn from public service to police confrontations, the social contract fractures.

Green Councillor Charged
Evidence: public service, criminal charges, accountability
#Aletheia #UKPolitics

Siobhan Harper-Nunes was elected to represent Ladywood, framed as a dedicated community advocate working for local constituents.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +1.00) — Good Preference

Police charged her with multiple assaults on officers, staff, and a member of the public, followed by a harassment arrest.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.56, -0.57) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Destruction.
A trusted public official facing multiple assault and harassment charges breaks the core covenant of community safety.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.0, Uncertainty z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Siobhan Harper-Nunes: FAIL (-0.85, -0.90) — Charged with multiple assaults and harassment, directly contradicting the public service mandate.

A Birmingham city councillor and former mayoral candidate was arrested and charged with assaulting three police officers, police staff, and a member of the public, alongside subsequent harassment charges.

The Bright Side:
Swift police intervention ensured immediate public protection and held an elected official accountable to the same laws as any citizen.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a failure of Logical and Metaphysical planes (WHO/HOW). The stated beneficiary of public leadership became the direct target of aggressive lawbreaking.

Social Physics Analysis:
Elected office requires transparency and empowerment, yet personal volatility introduces destructive conflict. When representatives weaponize presence against civil servants, social trust collapses.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated public trust and criminal assault charges, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Mathematical vector psi tends strongly negative.

The Unavoidable Truth: Elected officials are fully subject to criminal law and public accountability for violent acts.

The Unavoidable Lie: Political office grants immunity or moral elevation above basic civic conduct.

Alethekanon:
Elected office is a public trust, not a shield. When a representative attacks the very officers keeping order, the social fabric tears.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts to see people who sought to help communities stumble into such deep pain and conflict. We hope everyone heals.

Brothekanon:
Imagine running for mayor and then getting booked for scrapping with cops on Monument Road. Wild timeline.
